title: Wombats Poop CUBES?!
summary: Wombats poop cubes! 🟫 Bare-nosed wombats from Australia make cube-shaped poop, about 80 to 100 pieces a night. Scientists found the cubes form in the last part of the wombat's intestine, where stiffer and stretchier sections of the gut wall squeeze the poop into flat sides and sharp corners. Wombats leave the cubes on rocks and logs to mark their turf, and cubes don't roll away! The research won the 2019 Ig Nobel Prize in Physics.
script: Wait. This animal poops... cubes?!
Meet the wombat. A chubby little marsupial from Australia.
And its poop comes out shaped like tiny cubes.
Up to a hundred of them a night!
Scientists finally figured out how. The cubes form in the last part of the wombat's intestine,
where stiff and stretchy sections squeeze the poop into flat sides and sharp corners.
Wombats stack them on rocks and logs to mark their turf. And cubes don't roll away!
That research even won an Ig Nobel Prize.

title: Cleopatra Was Closer to the MOON LANDING?!
full_title: Cleopatra Was Closer to the MOON LANDING?! #ThrowbackThursday
summary: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Apollo 11 Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid of Giza! 🏛️🚀 The Great Pyramid was built for the pharaoh Khufu around 4,500 years ago. By the time Cleopatra was born (around 69 BC), it was already more than 2,000 years old, and the Moon landing in 1969 came about 2,000 years after her. When it was new, the pyramid was covered in smooth white limestone and stood about 147 meters tall.
script: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing... than to the building of the pyramids?!
The Great Pyramid of Giza was built for the pharaoh Khufu, about forty-five hundred years ago.
Cleopatra was born around 69 BC. By then, the pyramid was already more than two thousand years old!
And the Apollo 11 Moon landing? That was in 1969, about two thousand years after Cleopatra.
So on the timeline, Cleopatra sits closer to us than to the pyramid builders!
Back then, the Great Pyramid was covered in smooth white limestone, and stood about 147 meters tall.

title: Bananas Are Berries… Strawberries Aren't?!
summary: Botanically, bananas are true berries — but strawberries aren't! 🍌🍓 A berry grows from one flower with a single ovary (soft flesh, usually lots of seeds). Bananas check every box, and so do grapes, tomatoes, and oranges. A strawberry is an accessory fruit: the juicy red part is the flower's swollen base, and those little yellow “seeds” on the outside are the real fruits (achenes).
script: Your strawberry isn't a berry... but your banana is?!
In botany, a berry grows from one flower with a single ovary — soft flesh, and usually lots of seeds.
Bananas check every box. So do grapes, tomatoes, and oranges!
A strawberry? The juicy red part isn't even the fruit — it's the flower's swollen base.
Those little yellow dots on the outside? Those are the real fruits, called achenes!
So bananas are berries... and strawberries are the rebels of the fruit bowl!
